subject: Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force
overview: Host John Petrella interviews North Medford Ambassador Nate Rubright about the city's Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force. Rubright outlines his volunteer role connecting residents with municipal services, building neighborhood ties, and serving as an informational liaison.

items.title: Introduction
items.summary: Host John Petrella welcomes North Medford Ambassador Nate Rubright to discuss the purpose and activities of the Ambassador Task Force.

items.title: Guest Background
items.summary: Rubright describes his background as a North Medford resident, youth minister at Grace Episcopal Church, and writer for Gotta Know Medford.

items.title: Ambassador Program Role and Structure
items.summary: Rubright clarifies that ambassadors are unpaid, non-elected volunteers who learn municipal operations to help guide neighbors to the appropriate city departments.

items.title: North Medford Community and Carr Park
items.summary: Rubright discusses building local community connections and highlights Carr Park as a vital gathering space following its recent renovations.

items.title: Resident Outreach and Municipal Liaison Work
items.summary: Rubright explains his approach to resident communications and describes meeting with city departments, including Parking and DEI, to better navigate resident inquiries.

items.title: Neighborhood Meetings and Community Benefits
items.summary: Rubright outlines upcoming city-led neighborhood listening sessions and shares examples of helping residents coordinate street block parties and accessibility inquiries.

items.title: Conclusion and Contact Information
items.summary: Petrella thanks Rubright for his service and shares viewing and contact details for Medford Happenings.
